property.description: CPU0 configures shared clocks before starting CPU1. PLL startup requires the reset clock and module-stop state; runtime PLL retuning is unsupported.

option.display: 24 MHz crystal PLL: CPU0 240 MHz, CPU1/buses 60 MHz
